title: 第二十五章 炉身剑第二十六章 黑色羽毛
content_zh:
罗冠消化完心头震动，正要离开时突然发现，地面一个钱袋，材质看着很眼熟。想到之前，秦业提到的钱袋，两人被疯狂追杀的原因，似乎并非血库而是此物。
他俯身捡起，金票财物放一边，从里面翻出一封被小心封存，仍保存完好书信。确定没不妥，罗冠将信看了一遍，内容不长却很晦涩，一些语句明显是故意遮掩。
但他还是从中，找到一些关键信息，比如这封信来自帝都，而秦家似乎正与，某位贵人进行某种隐秘的，不愿被人知晓的交易。
又看了一遍，没更多收获后，罗冠望着昏睡中的许珂，暗道本以为是我连累你，没想到还是你的锅。
可如今，不是考虑这些的时候，罗冠走出石室，沉声道：“老师，我如今状态恢复许多，能不能再用击杀秦业那一剑？”
“想都别想。”玄龟警告他，“那一剑，远超出你承受极限，根基都已受损，再用一次你就废了。”
罗冠苦笑，他也感觉自身状态不对，可这里没有食物……呃，就算许珂可以喝他的血，他也得吃饭啊。
周老守在外面，那老东西给罗冠的感觉很危险，不能动用那一剑，他绝非其对手。再拖下去，一旦秦家高手追来，两人就危险了。
如今看似安全，可实际上他们已在绝境！
“小子，这里好歹是一座仙途境的遗留洞府，你真以为看一遍，就没有遗漏了？”玄龟老神在在，意有所指。
罗冠眼神一亮，“老师是说，这座洞府里，有能助我们脱困之物？”
玄龟道：“能不能脱困不知道，但东西是有的。”它指点罗冠来到另一间石室，正对门口的墙壁前，“将帝剑气息，打入这面墙。”
罗冠一指点落，剑息灌入石壁，只听“啪”一声轻响，石壁表面禁制破碎，一副画卷从中浮现，材质未知略显枯黄，似已存世许久。
“这就是仙途手段？”罗冠面露怀不解，“这么简单，就能被破掉？”虽说神奇，可未免太过容易。
玄龟冷笑，“简单是因为，这禁制力量已损耗大半，还有就是……嗯，大荒十二帝剑在我看来，虽只是一门小道神通，但对这世间绝大部分人而言，已是通天大道！其威能，又岂是寻常可比！”
罗冠点点头，看向面前画卷，其上杂乱一片，只有无数交错线条，就像是一团理不清的线团，但这些线条间，却又隐约散发出一丝，锋芒锐利之感，让他双目微感刺痛。
“老师，这画卷上是什么？”
玄龟道：“一招剑式！”它短暂沉默，声音流露沉重，“创造这一剑的人，本身境界并不高，但其剑道天赋极其惊人，竟能另辟奇径做到这点，有点东西！”
“罗冠，为师学究天人所知包罗万象，之所以除了大荒十二帝剑外与永恒剑体外，并未传授给你其他功法，是怕你贪多嚼不烂。而且有时会的太多，反而会形成某种阻碍……但这一招剑式你可以学，若能参悟当可化解眼下危机。”
“只可惜，这剑式是残缺的，仅有眼前一副。”

罗冠面露喜意，但很快又担忧，“……老师，弟子能学会吗？”
能令玄龟重视，可知此剑不凡！
他压力很大。
玄龟：……
你小子在逗我？
大荒十二帝剑，你说悟就悟了，还担心这个？
“你悟性虽然差了点，但参悟这一剑，问题应不大。”
“咳！别浪费时间，赶紧开始吧！”
罗冠深吸口气，凝神看向画卷，那些本就隐约释放着凌厉气息的线条，陡然变得更加清晰，他耳边似乎听到了，剑鸣的声音，带着不甘与坚韧，在天地间响彻。
双目间的刺痛感，逐渐消失不见，那一道又一道线条，渐渐烙印在罗冠心神之中，化作某种传承。
石床上，许珂睫毛抖了抖，缓缓睁开双眼，意识陷入昏迷之前，她正在承受动用能力后的燃血反噬，可如今所有症状都消失……疑惑中，她看到了盖在身上的衣服。
掀开看了一眼，许珂低呼一声脸上涨红，赶紧把衣服穿上。犹豫再三，她从石室内出来，便看到了石壁前，闭目而立的罗冠。
眼神下意识落在那副画上，双眼一阵刺痛，许珂心头大惊急忙收回眼神——好厉害的剑，只一眼她竟觉得，自己像要被撕碎。
看样子，罗冠居然在参悟，他好厉害！
突然间，许珂眼神一凝，她看到了罗冠手腕处包裹的碎布，上面透出些许血色，想到自己体内无故消失的燃血反噬，她表情露出慌乱、不安。
就在这时，“啪”的一声轻响，将她眼神吸引过去，便见石壁上的画卷碎成齑粉。
罗冠吐出口气，睁开双眼，“你醒了？”
“啊……”许珂面露慌张，吃吃道：“醒……醒了好一会，看你站在画前不动，就没打搅你。”
content_en:
Luo Guan was shocked after digesting it. When he was about to leave, he suddenly found a money bag on the ground. The material looked familiar. Thinking of the money bag Qin Ye mentioned before, it seemed that the reason why the two of them were being chased madly was not the blood bank but this thing.
He leaned over to pick it up, put the gold stamp and property aside, and dug out a letter that was carefully sealed and still well preserved. After confirming that there was nothing wrong, Luo Guan read the letter. The content was not long but very obscure, and some sentences were obviously deliberately obscured.
But he still found some key information from it. For example, the letter came from the imperial capital, and the Qin family seemed to be conducting some kind of secret deal with a certain nobleman that they did not want others to know about.
After reading it again and finding nothing more, Luo Guan looked at the sleeping Xu Ke and thought to himself that I was the one who caused you trouble, but I didn't expect that it was still your fault.
But now, it was not the time to think about this. Luo Guan walked out of the stone room and said in a deep voice: "Teacher, I have recovered a lot now. Can I use the sword that killed Qin Ye again?"
"Don't even think about it." Black Turtle warned him, "That sword is far beyond your endurance limit. The foundation has been damaged. If you use it again, you will be useless."
Luo Guan smiled bitterly. He also felt that his condition was not right, but there was no food here... Well, even if Xu Ke could drink his blood, he still had to eat.
Mr. Zhou was guarding outside. The old man felt very dangerous to Luo Guan and he could not use that sword. He was definitely no match for him. If the delay continues, once the masters of the Qin family come after them, the two of them will be in danger.
It seems safe now, but in fact they are in dire straits!
"Boy, after all, this is a cave left behind in the Immortal Realm. Do you really think that after looking at it once, you won't miss anything?" The old god Xuangui was there and he meant something.
Luo Guan's eyes lit up, "Teacher, are you saying that there is something in this cave that can help us get out of trouble?"
Xuangui said: "I don't know if I can escape from the trap, but there are things." It pointed Luo Guan to another stone room, in front of the wall opposite the door, "Punch the aura of the Emperor's Sword into this wall."
Luo Guan pointed down, and the breath of the sword poured into the stone wall. There was only a soft "pop" sound, the surface of the stone wall was broken, and a picture scroll emerged from it. The material was unknown and slightly withered and yellow, as if it had been there for a long time.
"Is this the Immortal Way?" Luo Guan looked puzzled, "It's so simple, can it be broken?" Although it is magical, it is too easy.
Xuangui sneered, "Simply because most of the forbidden power has been lost, and also... well, in my opinion, the Twelve Emperor Swords of the Wilderness are just a small magical power, but to most people in this world, it is already a great way to reach the sky! How can its power be ordinary and comparable!"
Luo Guan nodded and looked at the scroll in front of him. It was a mess, with only countless intersecting lines, like an unclear ball of thread. However, there was a faint sense of sharpness between these lines, which made his eyes sting slightly.
"Teacher, what is on this scroll?"
Xuangui said: "A sword move!" It was silent for a moment, and its voice was heavy. "The person who created this sword is not very advanced, but his swordsmanship talent is extremely amazing. He can actually find a strange way to do this. There is something!"
"Luo Guan, I am a scholar who knows everything about heaven and man. The reason why I did not teach you any other skills except the Twelve Emperor Swords of the Wilderness and the Eternal Sword Body is because I am afraid that you will bite off more than you can chew. And sometimes there are too many, which will create some kind of obstacles... But you can learn this sword move. If you can understand it, you can resolve the current crisis."
"It's a pity that this sword style is incomplete, only the one in front of you."
Luo Guan looked happy, but soon became worried, "...Teacher, can this disciple learn it?"
If Xuan Turtle can take it seriously, you know that this sword is extraordinary!
He was under a lot of pressure.
Xuangui:......
Are you kidding me?
The Twelve Emperor Swords of the Great Wilderness, you realized it as soon as you said it, why are you still worried about this?
"Although your understanding is a bit lacking, it shouldn't be a big problem if you understand this sword."
"Ahem! Don't waste time, hurry upLet’s get started! "
Luo Guan took a deep breath and looked at the scroll attentively. The lines that were vaguely emitting a sharp aura suddenly became clearer. He seemed to hear the sound of swords ringing in his ears, with reluctance and tenacity, resounding throughout the world.
The tingling feeling between his eyes gradually disappeared, and the lines gradually became imprinted in Luo Guan's mind, turning into some kind of inheritance.
On the stone bed, Xu Ke fluttered her eyelashes and slowly opened her eyes. Before her consciousness fell into coma, she was suffering from the blood-burning backlash after using her abilities, but now all the symptoms had disappeared... In confusion, she saw the clothes covering her body.
After opening it and taking a look, Xu Ke whispered, his face flushed, and he quickly put on his clothes. After much hesitation, she came out of the stone chamber and saw Luo Guan standing in front of the stone wall with his eyes closed.
Her eyes subconsciously fell on the painting, and her eyes stung for a while. Xu Ke was frightened and quickly retracted her eyes - such a powerful sword, she felt as if she was going to be torn apart with just one glance.
It seems that Luo Guan is actually meditating. He is so powerful!
Suddenly, Xu Ke's eyes narrowed. She saw the rag wrapped around Luo Guan's wrist, with a little blood on it. Thinking of the backlash of the burning blood that disappeared for no reason in her body, her expression showed panic and uneasiness.
At this moment, a soft "snap" sound attracted her eyes, and she saw the scroll on the stone wall shattered into powder.
Luo Guan exhaled and opened his eyes, "Are you awake? "
"Ah..." Xu Ke looked panicked and said: "Wake up... I woke up for a long time. I saw you standing in front of the painting and didn't move, so I didn't bother you. "
